translations.literal: Gongshi was captured, sent to Danyang, and beheaded. The remaining partisans were hunted down separately and all executed. The Jiangnan region was fully pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Gongshi was captured, sent to Danyang, and beheaded. The remaining partisans were hunted down and all executed. Jiangnan was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以孝恭為東南道行台右僕射，李靖為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On jihai, Xiaogong was made Right Vice Director of the Southeast Route Regional Secretariat and Li Jing Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Xiaogong was appointed Right Vice Director of the Southeast Route Regional Secretariat and Li Jing Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 頃之，廢行台，以孝恭為楊州大都督，靖為府長史。

translations.literal: Before long the regional secretariat was abolished; Xiaogong was made Grand Area Commander of Yangzhou and Jing Grand Administrator of the headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the regional secretariat was abolished; Xiaogong was made Grand Area Commander of Yangzhou and Jing Grand Administrator of the headquarters.

sentences.zh: 上深美靖功，曰：「靖，蕭、輔之膏肓也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor greatly praised Jing's achievement, saying: "Jing was the malignancy in Xiao and Fu's vitals."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised Jing's achievement at length, saying, "Jing was the fatal disease festering in Xiao and Fu's flesh."

sentences.zh: 闞稜功多，頗自矜伐。

translations.literal: Kan Ling had many achievements and was rather self-congratulatory and boastful.
translations.idiomatic: Kan Ling had won many victories and was rather proud and boastful.

sentences.zh: 公祏誣稜與己通謀。

translations.literal: Gongshi falsely claimed Kan had conspired with him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongshi falsely claimed that Kan had conspired with him.

sentences.zh: 會趙郡王孝恭籍沒賊黨田宅，稜及杜伏威、王雄誕田宅在賊境者，孝恭並籍沒之；

translations.literal: When Prince of Zhao Commandery Xiaogong confiscated rebel partisans' fields and residences, the fields and residences of Kan, Du Fuwei, and Wang Xiongna that lay in rebel territory were also confiscated;
translations.idiomatic: When Prince of Zhao Commandery Li Xiaogong confiscated rebel partisans' fields and residences, the holdings of Kan, Du Fuwei, and Wang Xiongna that lay in rebel territory were confiscated as well;

sentences.zh: 稜自訴理，忤孝恭，孝恭怒，以謀反誅之。

translations.literal: Kan pleaded his own case, offending Xiaogong; Xiaogong grew angry and executed him on charges of plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Kan pleaded his case and offended Xiaogong; Xiaogong grew angry and executed him on charges of plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，庚子朔，赦天下。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day gengzi, a general amnesty was declared throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day gengzi, a general amnesty was declared throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是日，頒新律令，比開皇舊制增新格五十三條。

translations.literal: That same day, new statutes and ordinances were promulgated, adding fifty-three new regulations compared with the old Kaihuang system.
translations.idiomatic: That same day new statutes and ordinances were promulgated, adding fifty-three new regulations to the old Kaihuang system.

sentences.zh: 初定均田租、庸、調法：丁、中之民，給田一頃，篤疾減什之六，寡妻妾減七；

translations.literal: The equal-field, land-tax, corvée, and household-tax system was first established: for adult and middle-aged males, one qing of land was granted; for the severely ill, a reduction of six-tenths; for widows and concubines, a reduction of seven-tenths;
translations.idiomatic: The equal-field, land-tax, corvée, and household-tax system was first established: adult and middle-aged males were granted one qing of land; the severely ill received six-tenths less; widows and concubines received seven-tenths less;

sentences.zh: 皆以什之二為世業，八為口分。

translations.literal: of this, two-tenths were hereditary property and eight-tenths were allotted fields.
translations.idiomatic: of which two-tenths were hereditary property and eight-tenths were allotted fields.

sentences.zh: 每丁歲入租粟二石。

translations.literal: Each adult male paid two shi of grain in land tax per year.
translations.idiomatic: Each adult male paid two shi of grain in land tax each year.

sentences.zh: 調隨土地所宜，綾、絹、絁、布。

translations.literal: The corvée levy in kind followed what the land was suited to: damask, silk gauze, coarse silk, or cloth.
translations.idiomatic: The cloth levy varied with local conditions—damask, silk gauze, coarse silk, or plain cloth.

sentences.zh: 歲役二旬；

translations.literal: Labor service was twenty days per year;
translations.idiomatic: Corvée labor was twenty days a year;

sentences.zh: 不役則收其傭，日三尺；

translations.literal: if not serving, a commutation fee was collected at three chi per day;
translations.idiomatic: those who did not serve paid a commutation fee of three chi of cloth per day;

sentences.zh: 有事而加役者，旬有五日，免其調；

translations.literal: when extra labor was imposed for special tasks, fifteen days exempted the levy in kind;
translations.idiomatic: for extra labor on special projects, fifteen days of service exempted the cloth levy;

sentences.zh: 三旬，租、調俱免。

translations.literal: thirty days exempted both rent and levy in kind.
translations.idiomatic: thirty days exempted both grain rent and the cloth levy.

sentences.zh: 水旱蟲霜為災，什損四以上免租，損六以上免調，損七已上課役俱免。

translations.literal: When flood, drought, insects, or frost brought disaster, a loss of four-tenths or more exempted rent; six-tenths or more exempted the levy in kind; seven-tenths or more exempted all dues and labor.
translations.idiomatic: After flood, drought, pests, or frost, losses of forty percent or more exempted grain rent; sixty percent or more exempted the cloth levy; seventy percent or more exempted all taxes and labor.

sentences.zh: 凡民貲業分九等。

translations.literal: All commoners' property and livelihoods were graded into nine ranks.
translations.idiomatic: All households were ranked in nine grades according to wealth.

sentences.zh: 百戶為里，五里為鄉，四家為鄰，四鄰為保。

translations.literal: A hundred households made a li, five li made a xiang, four households made a lin, and four lin made a bao.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred households formed a li; five li formed a township; four households formed a neighborhood; four neighborhoods formed a mutual-security group.

sentences.zh: 在城邑者為坊，田野者為村。

translations.literal: Those in cities and towns were organized as wards; those in the countryside as villages.
translations.idiomatic: Urban residents were grouped into wards; rural residents into villages.

sentences.zh: 食祿之家，無得與民爭利；

translations.literal: Families receiving stipends might not compete with the people for profit;
translations.idiomatic: Officials on state stipends were forbidden to compete with commoners for profit;

sentences.zh: 工商雜類，無預士伍。

translations.literal: merchants, artisans, and miscellaneous classes did not serve in the militia.
translations.idiomatic: merchants, artisans, and other commoners of that kind were excluded from militia service.

sentences.zh: 男女始生為黃，四歲為小，十六為中，二十為丁，六十為老。

translations.literal: At birth males and females were classified huang; at four years xiao; at sixteen zhong; at twenty ding; at sixty lao.
translations.idiomatic: Newborns were classed as infants; at four years as minors; at sixteen as youths; at twenty as adult males liable for service; at sixty as elderly.

sentences.zh: 歲造計帳，三年造戶籍。

translations.literal: Each year an accounting register was compiled; every three years a household register.
translations.idiomatic: Annual registers were compiled; household registers were revised every three years.

sentences.zh: 丁未，党項寇松州。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Tangut raided Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Tangut raided Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，通事舍人李鳳起擊萬州反獠，平之。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Master of Communications Li Fengqi attacked the rebellious Lao of Wanzhou and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, master of communications Li Fengqi suppressed a Lao rebellion in Wanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，辛未，突厥寇朔州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinwei, the Turks raided Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinwei, the Turks raided Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，羌與吐谷渾同寇松州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Qiang and Tuyuhun together raided Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the Qiang and Tuyuhun jointly raided Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 遣益州行台左僕射竇軌自翼州道，扶州刺史蔣善合自芳州道擊之。

translations.literal: Dou Gui, Left Vice Director of the Yizhou Mobile Commandery, was dispatched by the Yizhou route and Jiang Shanhe, Prefect of Fuzhou, by the Fangzhou route to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Gui, left vice director on the Yizhou mobile staff, was sent along the Yizhou corridor and Jiang Shanhe, prefect of Fuzhou, along the Fangzhou corridor to drive them back.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，作仁智宮於宜君。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Renzhi Palace was built at Yijun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Renzhi Palace was built at Yijun.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，竇軌破反獠於方山，俘二萬餘口。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Dou Gui defeated the rebellious Lao at Fang Mountain and took more than twenty thousand captives.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Dou Gui routed the rebel Lao at Fang Mountain and took more than twenty thousand prisoners.
